svg.title: 主智能体运行流程时序图
svg.desc: 短篇、长篇与剧本共用的主智能体框架：模型选择工具，工具读取作品、加载技能、查询素材、委派子任务、生成提案，界面审批后由 Core 保存。

text.tspan: 主智能体运行流程｜短篇、长篇、剧本共用执行框架，按作品类型加载创作规则和工具

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 初始目录帮助模型选择要读什么；正文和技能、素材内容按需取得

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 技能提供写作方法；素材提供参考内容；作品设定与正文由作品工具读取

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [短篇或剧本]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 主、子智能体可看到同一本作品的本轮提案内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 修改已有非空文本前，操作者须先完整读取目标

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 技能正文进入会话，模型结合任务使用其中的方法

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 加载技能本身只返回文本，作品修改仍要调用写入工具

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 已配置素材查询通道时，经 Core 查询绑定库；否则使用本轮附加素材

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 素材供创作参考，只有被明确采用的内容才作为本书设定

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 主智能体等待本次调用结束；子智能体使用自己的提示词和工具清单

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 普通团队成员可继承主模型或配置独立模型；是否带主历史按成员类型决定

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [子任务需要读资料或提出修改]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [子智能体按任务反复调用模型与工具]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 普通团队成员没有 load_skill 与 ask_user_question；方法来自自己的提示词和任务

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 库管理子智能体另有工具，只在作者明确要求时管理指定的已绑定可写库

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 子智能体不能继续调用其它子智能体

font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [跨阶段写入，且未开启自动允许]

font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [模型决定下一步 → 工具执行 → 结果进入会话 → 继续请求模型]

font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: [主智能体执行任务；下面的提案审批和保存可同时进行]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

g.text: [每收到一笔主／子智能体的写入提案，界面处理保存]

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 下一次任务接续会话，并重新准备当时的作品上下文、提示词与工具

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 工具提供执行能力；技能提供方法；素材提供参考；子智能体承担明确子任务；Core 负责本地保存

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
text.tspan: 作者

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 提出任务，选择作品与当前内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 读取书籍规则与关联资料信息

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回规则、目录与可用资料信息

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 发送任务、作品上下文、技能与素材信息

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 附带模型、成员配置和审批设置

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 准备本轮提示词和工具；接续可用会话历史

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 按作品类型装配读写工具

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 发送创作规则、任务、会话消息、目录

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 提供可用工具名称、参数和子智能体名单

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回工具名称与参数

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 例如 read、load_skill、spawn_subagent

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 调用已注册工具，交给工具执行

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 检查参数、对象、读取与写入范围

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: read：从本轮作品快照读取

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 人物、剧情、正文或人物状态

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: list / read：通过授权通道查询目录与文档

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回结构或完整文档

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: load_skill：按名称选择

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 本轮已附加且有读取权限的技能

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回这项技能的完整正文

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 交给模型作为写作方法使用

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: query_linked_material_entries

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: list 找目录／search 找内容／read 读原文

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 按当前作品关联范围与读取权限查询素材

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回匹配条目、片段或原文

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 读取原文时返回当前可读内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回素材查询结果

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: ask_user_question：提交问题

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 展示需要明确的目标或条件

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 回答或取消

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回作者的选择

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: spawn_subagent：选择本轮可用成员

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 创建新的子智能体，传入明确任务

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 发送子任务、自己的规则和子会话内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回候选结果或工具调用

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 使用本轮分配的读取、素材查询或写入工具

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 编辑前须用自己的工具完整读取

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回读取结果或提案状态

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 写入提案同步进入界面审批流程

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回最终交接摘要；主智能体继续执行

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 检查目标、读取证据和当前版本

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: create / edit / delete；长篇另有连续性提案工具

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 请求允许这一笔跨阶段操作

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 展示准备修改的目标

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 允许本次操作或取消

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回决定；取消则不生成该提案

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 操作获允许后发送修改提案与差异

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 由界面接手审批与保存

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回内容、提案状态或错误

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 工具本次结束，主智能体继续判断

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 将工具结果加入会话，再次请求模型

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 模型可继续读资料、调用成员或处理错误

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 无需继续调用工具时，返回最终回复

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 展示回复与任务状态

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 区分待审提案、已保存结果和失败项

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 查看回复，继续提要求或修改作品

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 展示提案内容或修改差异

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 接受或拒绝；拒绝则不写文件

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 按保存规则将提案排入队列

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 应用提案，并检查当前作品版本

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 校验允许应用后，原子写入文件和索引

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 发生冲突或错误时保留已有内容

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 返回保存成功或错误

text.style: font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;

svg.text: 更新作品、提案状态与保存提示

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
text.tspan: 作者
